syntactic_simplification:
Mice are important in brain research. Scientists use mice to study how the brain works. They can control and observe the mice easily.

Researchers usually use male mice. They do this for a few reasons. One reason is that female mice have hormones. These hormones can change how female mice behave. This can make research results unclear.
lexical_simplification:
Mice are very important in brain studies. Scientists use mice to learn how the brain works. They can manage and watch the mice easily.

Researchers usually use boy mice. They do this for a few reasons. One reason is that girl mice have special chemicals in their bodies called hormones. These hormones can change how girl mice act. This can make research results confusing.
paraphrase_or_explanation:
Mice are very important in studying the brain. Scientists use mice to learn how the brain works because it is easy to take care of them and watch what they do.

Researchers often choose boy mice for their studies. They do this for a couple of reasons. One reason is that girl mice have special chemicals in their bodies that are called hormones. Hormones can make girl mice act differently at different times. This can make it hard to understand the research results.

source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text:
Mice are important for studying the brain. Scientists use them to learn how the brain works because they are easy to care for and watch.

Researchers usually pick boy mice for their studies. One reason is that girl mice have special chemicals called hormones. Hormones can make girl mice act differently at different times. This can make the study results hard to understand.
